description: Explore the City in Style with the Nadine 7-Speed Women’s City Bike Discover the perfect city companion with the Nadine 7-Speed Women's City Bike, available in sleek Classic Black and refreshing Mint Green. This versatile, lightweight bike is designed with a convenient low step-through frame, making it easy to mount and dismount for all your urban adventures. Equipped with a Shimano 7-speed gear system, the Nadine smoothly transitions from flat streets to mild hills, making it ideal for both daily commutes and leisurely weekend rides. Both color options offer unique appeal: Classic Black adds a timeless, refined look to your commute, while Mint Green brings a lively touch to your city rides. Each bike is thoughtfully crafted with ergonomic grips and a comfortable saddle to make every journey more enjoyable. Plus, with the added convenience of a rear rack and fenders, the Nadine is built for functionality and style, regardless of the weather or terrain. Key Features: Lightweight, low step-through frame for easy on-and-off access Reliable 7-speed Shimano drivetrain for adaptable performance Comfortable saddle and ergonomic grips for extra support Functional fenders and rear rack for added utility and protection Available in Classic Black and Mint Green for distinct style choices Rediscover urban biking with the Nadine—an ideal blend of performance, comfort, and timeless style, crafted to elevate every ride. Frame: XDSBIKE Alloy Frame Frame Size: 17" Colors: Black Fork: Steel Fork Wheels: Alloy 700C x 1.5 36H Tires: Kenda Tire 700C x 32C Hub: KT Alloy Hub with QR Spokes:14G Stainless Steel Crankset: Prowheel 44Tx170 Alloy Crank Chain: KMC Z51 Bottom Bracket: Cartridge Type Pedal: VP608 Alloy Derailleurs: Shimano RD-TX3007 Speed Shiftlevers: Shimano SL-RS35 7 Speed Freewheels: Shimano MF-TZ21 14-28T 7sp Brake Lever: Tektro Alloy Brake: Caliper Brake Alloy Handlebar: HL Alloy 595mm Stem: HL Alloy φ22mm E:80mm Grips:Synthetic Leather Saddle: VL-8024 Comfort Saddle Seatpost: Alloy 2mm x 300mm Seat Clamp: Alloy, QR Type Fender, Rear Rack: Included Weight of the Bike: 30 lbs Recommended Rider Height: Fits riders 5’3“ – 6’1” Tall The Hybrid City Cummuter Bike Series is, plain and simple, an eye catcher. The classic style evokes a sense of nostalgia that is rare among modern bicycles. This series doesn't sacrifice capability for looks though, as they are also built to meet your needs and make every ride enjoyable and convenient. The Nadine 7sp City Bike allows you to do more and do it in style. For storage, this bike is equipped with a rear-mounted rack and fender. For convenience, the Nadine has quick-release wheels, a 7-Speed Tourney shifting system, front brakes, rear brakes, and fenders to keep you and your luggage clean and dry.
